tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: Tourism can have a profound impact on local communities. Some people believe that tourism is among the best industries because it brings money into local communities and strengthens the local economy. Others argue that large numbers of visitors can harm local communities in many ways, such as by increasing prices and causing traffic problems. In your opinion, does tourism bring more benefits or more harm to a local community? Why?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: The local community is harmed more. I live in a tourist town. In my childhood, our streets were charming and intimate, but over the years, many large restaurants and hotels have popped up to serve tourists. I feel that some of the charm of my town is gone because of tourism.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: The economic benefits outweigh any potential harm. Many tourist destinations are in remote areas with limited job opportunities. Tourism creates jobs for restaurant staff, tour guides, hotel workers, and many others. Young people in the local community can gain work experience and develop new skills.
